scope: Prospective development of matched history contrasts on an adaptively selected head. Comparative prediction only: no absolute adequacy, unique mechanism, native-use, or untouched-head claim.

sampling.phase_meaning: Existing input hash partition, not the epistemic status of this development round.
sampling.sampling: Independent draws with replacement across families; four distinct matched stems within each family; two calibration and two target stems.
sampling.historical_exclusions: All prior prepared strings, including all unmeasured averaged_anchors_004 inputs; exclude their full strings and first20/28 prefixes.

screen.rule: m<8 in both fp32 and fp64
screen.selection: First256 accepted in fixed candidate order; finish all2048 before selecting.
screen.shortfall: insufficient_screening_yield; no calibration, replenishment, cutoff change or replacement

intervention.recipient_site: highest native fp64 EOS attention on a closing bracket; first tie
intervention.shared_future_suffix: Four symbols containing three opens and one close, identical within each quartet.

predictions.centering: For each matched four-cell stem quartet, subtract its four-cell mean separately. This fixed contrast removes additive shared offsets; it does not fit a target parameter.
predictions.calibration: Average the two centered calibration quartets cellwise.
predictions.H_recency: Predict centered cell from its recency-row mean in the calibrated grid.
predictions.H_suffix: Predict centered cell from its suffix-column mean in the calibrated grid.
predictions.H_constant: Predict zero for all centered cells.
predictions.target_scoring: Maximum absolute error across all eight centered fresh target cells per family, never an error of an averaged target.
predictions.receipt: All256 candidate forecast grids in both dtypes saved and hashed before any target transfer.
predictions.descriptive: Raw margins, centered grids, row/column/interaction contrasts and full-cell calibration forecasts are reported without additional inferential claims.

target_start.separation: At least one of the three primary forecast pairs has sup-norm distance strictly above .022 nat in BOTH dtypes; precision gates apply. Boundary-straddling pairs are reported as ambiguous and do not supply definite separation.
target_start.justification: Operational minimum potential coverage of25%; not inherited from004, not an estimated success rate, and not a guarantee of power. By the triangle inequality a forecast distance <=.022 cannot produce a robust error advantage >.022.
target_start.scope: After all calibration forecasts; if passed, measure and score all256 families, including nonseparating ones.
target_start.failure: insufficient_design_yield; preserve calibration records, measure no targets, add no families.

inference.independent_unit: Recipient-donor family draw, not any cell, stem, dtype or forward.
inference.population: All256 screened family draws under this fixed generator, conditional on the specified native eligibility population; no post-target subset.
inference.test: Three two-sided exact sign/binomial tests on robust family wins and losses; neutral cases remain in denominators and are not binomial trials.
inference.null: For a pair, robust wins and losses have equal population probability. A significant direction supports a higher probability of a meaningful prediction advantage, not mean-loss superiority.
inference.robust_win: In fp64, E_other-E_candidate>.022 nat; loss if below-.022; otherwise neutral. Every signed prediction error must agree across fp32/fp64 within.001, bounding the error-difference discrepancy by.002 and guaranteeing a robust win exceeds.020 in the other dtype. No extra agreement at the .022 guard boundary is required.
inference.decision: Report each pair independently with direction or unresolved; allow cycles, ties and multiple unresolved pairs. Do not force a unique mechanism or compatible explanation set.
inference.planning_note: Hypothetical robust-outcome probabilities for planning only; not forecasts from previous outcomes. Error control is for the predeclared procedure, not conditional on a passed data-dependent start gate.

future_confirmation_start.meaning: No automatic continuation, new head, revision or confirmation. Report all pair results and seek a separately frozen review.

provenance.design_development: Two history edits proposed after004. Only input algebra, old prepared strings and synthetic outcomes are used to prepare005; no new model outcomes.
